title: Universal machine startup configuration
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine-coding scheme, and let $\alpha$ and $x$ be finite Boolean strings. There exist a time $t$ and contents and head positions for the canonizer’s work tapes such that $t$ is at most the startup bound for $c$ and $\alpha$, and after $t$ steps the universal machine started on the paired encoding of $\alpha$ and $x$ is in the right-block extension of the decoded machine’s initial configuration on $x$. In that configuration, the interpreter’s table cursor is at $2\ell+q_0+3$, where $\ell$ is the length of the binary representation of the decoded machine’s number of states and $q_0$ is its initial state index.
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective machine-coding scheme, and let $\alpha$ and $x$ be finite
Boolean strings. There exist a time $t$ no greater than the startup bound determined by
$c$ and $\alpha$, together with contents and head positions for the canonizer’s tapes,
such that after $t$ steps the universal machine, started on the pair encoding of
$\alpha$ and $x$, is the right-block extension of the interpreter configuration for the
decoded machine’s initial configuration on $x$. The interpreter configuration has its
table cursor at $2\ell+q_0+3$, where $\ell$ is the length of the binary representation
of the decoded machine’s number of states and $q_0$ is its initial state index.
